answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the thread of the next round. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the lantern of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
